items.title: Albert Jiles Interview, 1960-06-15
items.q: Talbot. And Lester Lewis on piano, myself and Albert Buerbank.

ctx.x: Had you made any other records? We know you made that one little record that we just copied. You know, made that copy of the Four Piece Band with Burbank. Yeah. And let's see, who else was on it now? Talbot. Oh, yes.
Talbot. And Lester Lewis on piano, myself and Albert Buerbank.

Do you think about Lewis, can you, because of course we know, we didn't know Talbot, I knew him fairly well, but we never got to interview him of course. He died several years ago. Yeah. Can you tell us anything about Lewis?
